name: Fluffy Scrambled Eggs with Toasted Sourdough & Jam
whyItWorks: Farm fresh eggs scrambled soft in a non-stick pan provide top-tier bioavailable protein. Combined with toasted artisan sourdough bread and seedless strawberry or grape jam, it is ideal for Crohn's flare recovery.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request eggs cooked soft with light cooking spray or oil, plain sourdough toast lightly buttered, and seedless jelly.
